title: Method record (standard or fast)
description: One solving method for a question family (SESSION 009 / SPEC-PYQ-002). A method carries a state that says exactly how it was obtained and, if it is a fast method, whether it has been mathematically verified. The six states are exclusive: OBSERVED_STANDARD, MODEL_DERIVED, EXPERT_SOURCED, VERIFIED_FAST_METHOD, UNVERIFIED_FAST_METHOD, NO_FAST_METHOD_FOUND. A method never silently becomes a higher state; promotion requires the matching evidence. Validated by hand-written checks in tests/pyq/test_pyq_intelligence.py (D-0006).

state.description: How this method was obtained and whether it is verified. NO_FAST_METHOD_FOUND is a truthful negative — it means no fast method was identified, not that none exists.

description.description: The method, step by step, in plain language.

when_usable.description: Conditions under which this method applies (for a fast method, the conditions that make it valid).

when_not_to_use.description: Cases where the method fails or is unsafe. Must be explicit for any fast method.

derived_from.description: Where the method itself came from.

time_advantage.description: Estimated time saved, in seconds, vs the standard. Only ever present when a fair comparison is justified; null otherwise.

expert_source_ref.description: Required iff state == EXPERT_SOURCED. Not Instagram or YouTube.

source_document_ids.description: Paper IDs whose questions this method is observed on.

invariants: state == VERIFIED_FAST_METHOD  =>  verification_id is non-null and resolves to a verification record whose result is PASS
state == EXPERT_SOURCED  =>  expert_source_ref is non-null and is not an Instagram or YouTube URL
state == UNVERIFIED_FAST_METHOD  =>  verification_id is null; a fast method not yet checked is explicitly unverified
state == NO_FAST_METHOD_FOUND  =>  this is a recorded negative, not a claim that no method exists
a MODEL_DERIVED or UNVERIFIED method is never presented as EXPERT_SOURCED or VERIFIED without the matching evidence
a method is never T1_OFFICIAL; it is an analysis over T2 evidence
